sourceNotes.rawContent:
Description:
Brighten up your festive look with this stunning multicolor glass bangle set, beautifully adorned with golden polka-dot accents. Featuring a vibrant mix of pink, yellow, blue, and orange hues, these bangles add an instant pop of color to any ethnic outfit.
Handcrafted from premium-quality glass, this bangle set combines traditional artistry with a playful modern touch, making it perfect for weddings, festivals, parties, and everyday ethnic wear. The golden dotted detailing adds a subtle sparkle, enhancing your festive charm.
Lightweight yet durable, these bangles are comfortable for long wear and versatile enough to pair with sarees, lehengas, salwar suits, and indo-western ensembles. Whether you're shopping for bridal jewellery, festive accessories, or a unique gift, this multicolor bangle set is a must-have in every jewellery collection.
Key Features:
-
Vibrant multicolor glass bangles with golden polka dots
-
Handcrafted for a unique and elegant look
-
Lightweight and comfortable for daily or festive wear
-
Perfect for weddings, cultural events, and gifting
-
Complements all types of ethnic and fusion outfits
